clause_successors.subject: M3 entry
clause_successors.successor: Bounded T0/T1 development engineering may be prepared using reviewed exact inputs of an existing ExperimentAuthorizationProfile before complete M2. Complete M3 verdict, T2/T3 scale expansion and all qualification/release paths still require complete accepted M2.

clause_successors.subject: Dataset purpose, selection separation and final Holdout freeze
clause_successors.successor: Before candidate-selection feedback, really freeze reserved source-pool manifest, near-duplicate groups, sampling version/size/statistical rationale, custody, allowed consumers, scorer/threshold/failure rules and actual access isolation. Generate actual final_holdout questions only through the independent authorized path after the final product candidate weights/tokenizer/inference config/scorer are fixed and before formal product qualification.

clause_successors.subject: M2 acceptance and DataGate
clause_successors.successor: Freeze the exact M2 reference/deterministic baseline for its qualification purpose first. Then independently generate and consume qualification-purpose samples with actual Gold, thresholds, sources and applicable evidence to close DataGate. This reference is not the later M3-trained product candidate. DevelopmentFoundation and source-bound preparation never issue M2 PASS.

clause_successors.subject: Acceptance evidence and final product qualification
clause_successors.successor: M2 qualification data acceptance precedes full M3; product final_holdout use follows exact product candidate freeze. Distinct purpose-bound candidate/evidence identities and independent acceptance apply. M2 consumption of qualification samples grants no final_holdout use or final product qualification inheritance.
